desc: Cole-TAC's engineers designed their Brain Bucket Bag to keep your sensitive equipment safe and secure during storage and transport. This valuable addition to your kit shields helmets and night vision from UV rays, dust, shock, and prying eyes. Their Brain Bucket Bag opens along its entire length, making it easy to load and unload a fully kitted-out helmet without snags. they padded the bag's interior to improve shock resistance and keep your kit undamaged. A full panel of Velcro loop on the inside lets you keep a gallery of strobes, beacons, organizers, and IR patches handy.
